name: sistema-comercial
description: Sistema comercial desktop com API central e PostgreSQL

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @sistema/contracts && concurrently -k -n api,desktop "npm run dev --workspace @sistema/api" "npm run dev --workspace @sistema/desktop"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @sistema/contracts && npm run dev --workspace @sistema/api
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build --workspace @sistema/contracts && npm run dev --workspace @sistema/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @sistema/contracts && npm run build --workspace @sistema/api && npm run build --workspace @sistema/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @sistema/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @sistema/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @sistema/desktop
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @sistema/contracts && npm run test --workspace @sistema/api
